'''Rekt Kedand''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], where he built and sold [[Armor/Legends|armor]], as well as armor upgrades and materials, in a small shop.
